# Trama

> Trama (https://trama.app) is a visual editor for branching interactive stories: authors connect passages, choices, stats, conditions and random or conditional routes on a node board, and readers play them in the browser. Stories can also be played in any custom interface with the open-source engine @trama-app/engine (MIT, no dependencies).

Key facts for building on Trama:

- Play stories only through @trama-app/engine. Do not reimplement the rules (random joins, distributors, requirements, events, variables) by reading the story JSON.
- A story is read by id or by its custom address (slug) with `fetchStory()` or the public API. Stories cannot be listed, and there is no public write API.
- Reading links look like `https://trama.app/<slug>` or `https://trama.app/private/<id>`.
- Passages and answers are author HTML: render them as HTML and sanitize them.

## Engine

- [@trama-app/engine README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GerardEst/trama/main/packages/engine/README.md): install, load a story, play it, render scenes, save games
- [Engine API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GerardEst/trama/main/skills/trama-engine/references/engine-api.md): every function, type and event
- [Story format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GerardEst/trama/main/skills/trama-engine/references/story-format.md): the story JSON (nodes, joins, answers, events, requirements, distributors, refs, text tokens)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@trama-app/engine): `npm install @trama-app/engine`, or import `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@trama-app/engine@0.1.0/+esm` in the browser

## Public API

- [Story endpoint](https://lsemostpqoguehpsbzgu.supabase.co/functions/v1/story): `GET ?id=<uuid>` or `GET ?slug=<slug>` returns `{ id, name, slug, settings, tree }` as JSON, ready for `createGame(tree)`. 404 when it does not exist. CORS is open.

## Agent skill

- [trama-engine skill (zip)](https://trama.app/skills/trama-engine.zip): ready to upload to claude.ai (Settings → Capabilities → Skills). In Claude Code: `/plugin install trama-engine --marketplace GerardEst/trama`
- [trama-engine skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GerardEst/trama/main/skills/trama-engine/SKILL.md): instructions for coding agents to build players, maps and analyses of Trama stories
- [Player template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GerardEst/trama/main/skills/trama-engine/assets/player.html): a complete single-file player that behaves like Trama's own
- [Story outline script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GerardEst/trama/main/skills/trama-engine/scripts/story-outline.mjs): compact outline and structural checks of a story (Node 18+)

## Editor

- [Full product summary](https://trama.app/llms-full.txt): capabilities, examples, comparisons and frequently asked questions from the landing.

- [Features guide](https://trama.app/docs/features): how authors set up each editor feature (content nodes, events, conditional paths, requirements, distributors, player input, variables, images, sharing), with an example and its limitations. Also in Spanish (/es/docs/features) and Catalan (/ca/docs/features).
